package.name: csa_bridge
package.description: Drop-in CSA compression for one bandwidth-constrained pose topic: subscribes to geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped, batches and compresses with the real CSA C++ codec (via bindings/python/csa.py's ctypes wrapper around libcsa, not a reimplementation), publishes csa_bridge_msgs/msg/CompressedPoseBatch; a matching decompressor node turns it back into an ordinary PoseStamped stream on the receiving end. Sits alongside your existing rosbag2/MCAP recording of the source topic, not instead of it -- see this package's README.md for why (and the real, measured numbers in ADVERSARIAL_BENCHMARK.md showing where MCAP's own default zstd compression loses badly on exactly this kind of data).
